title: Conformance vector
description: One thing to check, and what it should produce. Vectors live in conformance/vectors/<subject>/<case>.json, and a message subject uses the message name in kebab-case as its directory.

subject.description: What this vector checks. A transport vector checks that the packet header was built correctly, and its payload is immaterial. A cipher vector checks the cipher alone and is not a packet.

message.description: Identity of the message these bytes carry.

version.description: Client version these bytes were taken from. Selects the revision.

bytes.description: The deciphered channel payload, in hexadecimal, whitespace ignored, first byte included. Bytes that identify a person are zeroed before committing.

fields.description: What the bytes decode to. A field the revision defines but that a presence rule leaves out is written as null.

version.description: Client version these bytes were taken from. Selects the revision.

bytes.description: One packet header, in hexadecimal, whitespace ignored. Whatever follows the header is immaterial and need not appear.

fields.description: What the bytes decode to. A field the revision defines but that a presence rule leaves out is written as null.

plaintext.description: Input to the cipher, in hexadecimal.

ciphertext.description: What the cipher produces, in hexadecimal.
